4. By taking suitable sets A, B, C, verify the following results:
(v) (B − A) ∩ C = (B ∩ C) − A = B ∩ (C − A).

en: B ∩ C = {3, 4}; removing A gives (B ∩ C) − A = {3, 4}.
All three expressions equal {3, 4} for the chosen sets.
For any x, membership in each expression is equivalent to x ∈ B AND x ∈ C AND x ∉ A. Therefore the equality holds for arbitrary sets A, B, C.

answer.en: Each expression equals {3, 4} for the chosen sets; the membership argument proves the identity for all sets.
